description: Get the major shareholders of a company listed on B3, for one B3 listing written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:VALE3), as the company's newest reference form states them: holders of 5% or more of a share class, controllers and members of a shareholder agreement, each with common, preferred and total shares and percentages, nationality and marks for controller and agreement, then the company's treasury shares and every other share. A company holder lists the owners behind it, with percentages of that holder's own capital, not of the company's. Also returns issued capital in reais and shares issued, free float, treasury shares and how many individual, company and institutional shareholders the company has. For a US listing's holders use GetAllHolders.

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:VALE3. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.
